message.content:
This vertical rectangular editorial illustration features a red background. At the top, the black serif word "TEMPO" is prominent. Smaller text above and below includes "Gerilya Menggergaji Airlangga Hartarto H.24," "Barisan Investasi Merugi PGN H.78," and "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU."

A man with glasses, a white shirt, and black pants stands on top of a large, dark military-style peaked cap with a red band and a silver emblem. He looks upward, juggling a wooden gavel and two bundles of paper currency. Another gavel and more currency bundles float nearby.

The large white text "PESTA PORA NIKEL ILEGAL" is positioned on the left. Smaller white text below begins with "Tersangka megakorupsi pemancar Internet di Kejaksaan Agung, Windu Aji Sutanto..." and ends with "H.64."

At the bottom right, there is a barcode, a QR code, and text including "24-30 JULI 2023," "RP 50.000," "MAJALAH.TEMPO.CO," "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "ISSN: 0126-4273." The peaked cap occupies the bottom third of the frame.
